templates.title: Screen
templates.summary: A @Composable that implements the UI of one screen. One <Name>Screen.kt per :feature:<name>

templates.title: ViewModel

templates.summary: The destination of a screen. The only entrance a feature exposes to the outside

templates.title: Shared component
templates.summary: A part in the component package of the :ui module, used across features
